notes.title: Free 18+ patch added as DLC!
notes.content:
Thanks to Valve's new policy in allowing adult only titles, Love Ribbon's adult patch has been added as a free DLC:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26932360/59c15dace3ea5a3d7f1696c4a7a191278d57fe73.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/943730/Love_Ribbon_Adult_Patch/
 
After the uncertain future for games with risque content faced previously, I'm legitimately thrilled that Valve is approving adult content on it's storefront. If you have the game installed, and your settings allow adult only titles, the patch should be installed automatically.

-Razz

notes.title: Free "Afterstory" update now live
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/1oRzGjR.jpg
The Afterstory/Extended Epilogue update for Love Ribbon is now live! This is a free update that adds an additional epilogue piece to Love Ribbon plus new artworks. It will feature the two in more cute situations after the good end, as well as answering the question: How does Iris’ father react to their relationship? 

You can view the new addition in two places: Click the new ‘Afterstory’ button on the title screen or play through the main story to the good end.

This update is applied through Steam automatically, so if it hasn’t appeared yet, try closing and reopening Steam or checking your download settings.

I hope you enjoy seeing Iris and Zoey again plus a sweeter conclusion to their love story. 

-Razz

edit: Fix if the download is not appearing:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/559610/discussions/0/1318835718931684735/

notes.title: Love Ribbon "Afterstory" update coming soon
notes.content:
http://razzartvisual.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/FREEDOM-%E2%98%85.gif
First off, a huge massive thank you to all the fans of Love Ribbon! I was overjoyed to see so much support for the game in terms of steam reviews (over 300+ and counting!), overseas interest, and so many nice comments about the game.  

I am putting the finishing touches on an update that will add an additional epilogue piece to Love Ribbon. This will feature the two in more cute situations after the good end, as well as answering the question: How does Iris’ father react to their relationship?

This update will be 100% free, so please keep your eyes peeled for when it launches!
